profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Google DeepMind
profile.summary: I'm a software engineer at Google DeepMind's Gen AI group focused on audio capabilities. I obtained my B.S. in Computer Science and Business from Lehigh University and my M.S. from Columbia University. I am a hard worker and open to new ideas and innovations.

positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: As a software engineer at Google Deepmind's Gen AI area I work on developing the platform for the next generation of AI agents powered by Gemini.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer - Speech Recognition
positions.description: I work as a Software Engineer in Google Deepmind's Gen AI group focused on audio capabilities. My team develops the automatic captioning and dubbing systems used by YouTube and explores ways of leveraging multimodal LLMs for new use cases.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Speech Recognition
positions.description: I work as a Software Engineer in Google NYC's Speech Recognition group. My team develops the automatic captioning systems used by YouTube and explores ways of leveraging multimodal LLMs for new use cases.

positions.title: Independent Researcher
positions.description:
As part of an independent study initiative, I worked with Professor Sihong Xie to develop a novel method to extract attributes and opinions from product reviews.
• Method was able to identify troublesome product features and present them to a human for further inspection.
• Implemented multiple baseline methods to compare experimental results.

positions.title: Database Systems and Applications Head Grader
positions.description: As the head grader for Lehigh's relational database course I was in charge of  coordinating the grading efforts of the different assignments and projects for the three sections of the class, which included 133 students.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research  Assistant
positions.description:
As a research assistant at Lehigh University I worked on a block building application for Lehigh's School of Education performing multiple data mining tasks.
•	Implemented a data collection and analytics system for a block building application.
•	Implemented a resolution algorithm that would evaluate the complexity and type of constructions created through the application.
•	Improved the usability of the previous application version by redesigning the block movement system.

positions.title: Google Student Ambassador
positions.description: As Google's student ambassador at Lehigh, I am in charge of promoting the Google brand on campus. I am in charge of connecting the Lehigh community with Google by organizing on campus events and coordinating with Google recruiters to show the vast array of opportunities and programs Google has to offer.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
At iCIMS I worked on updating the internal web Single Sign On system. 
Added an extra layer of authentication for accessing customer sites through customer support tickets. 
Used Angular.js to implement multiple interfaces for administrators to manage permissions for different users and make changes to the database tables in a user friendly manner, instead of having users run SQL queries.

positions.title: Android Developer Intern
positions.description: At Callaghan I developed Android applications for different groups of employees. The goal is to make the employees' jobs both easier and more efficient by taking advantage of mobile devices.

volunteerExperiences.description: I taught English to Brazilian teenagers in Fortaleza, Brazil. I also was in charge of developing a water measuring system for a water tank for a twenty people urbanization.
